title.narrative: Tanzania Human Rights Defenders Coalition THRDC 2023-2025
Tanzania Human Rights Defenders Coalition THRDC 2023-2025

description.narrative:
Tanzania Human Rights Defenders Coalition (THRDC) is a non-governmental membership organisation registered under the NGO act. It has grown in importance since it was first formed 2012 and now comprises of almost 250 member organisations. THRDC is a strong player for Human Rights Defenders (HRDs) and has been able to build links with key national government institutions such as the Commission of Human Rights and Good Governance (CHRAGG), Registrar of NGO:s, police force and the legislature.
The main goal of THRDC is to enhance security and protection of the HRDs in Tanzania and to create a safer working environment. It also intends to strengthen regional and international interventions towards protection and promotion of the rights and responsibilities of the HRDs.
The Strategic Plan for 2023-2027 focus on three key results areas:
a. Preventive protection and security management: Assurance of preventive protection and security management of HRDs (who are at potential risks). b. Members empowerment and public engagement: Strengthen THRDC members and other stakeholders capacities and resilience. c. THRDCs institutional sustenance: Improvement of institutional performance and sustainability.

Tanzania Human Rights Defenders Coalition (THRDC) är en icke-statlig medlemsorganisation och registrerad NGO. Koalitionen har vuxit i betydelse sedan den först bildades 2012 och består nu av nästan 250 medlemsorganisationer. THRDC är en stark aktör för människorättsförsvarare och har kunnat bygga broar med viktiga nationella regeringsinstitutioner som Commission of Human Rights and Good Governance (CHRAGG), registrator of NGO:s, polisen och rättsväsendet.
Det huvudsakliga målet för THRDC är att förbättra säkerheten och skyddet av människorättsförsvarare i Tanzania och att skapa en säkrare arbetsmiljö för dessa. De avser också att stärka regionala och internationella insatser för att skydda och främja människors rättigheter och skyldigheter.

Outcome 1 Preventive protection and security management of HRDs are ensured
92 HRDs at risk supported with legal representations, evacuation, relocation and medical supports. ZCUs were capacitated on risk managementbased approach Human rights monitoring, documentation, and reporting Preventive security for HRDs (risk and threat assessment, and prevention and reaction to aggression) Inclusion and diversity in the context of the workplace environment and Psychosocial wellness for HRDs though training of total 11 Zonal Coordinators (5 Female).
ZCUs had their capacity on digital security improved through training on digital safety. A total of 17 (5 Female) IT personnel representing ZCUs participated in training. Topics covered included risk assessment, device hygiene and accounts security, secure security information, secure communication and email hygiene, online safety, phishing, and mobile security. They were also oriented on training/facilitating methods for training others when they go back to their zones.
199 HRDs (83 Female) had their capacity on legal aid improved through training organized and facilitated by THRDC. Participants were provided with an understanding of Human Rights Concepts and the Role of HRDs in Provision of Legal Aid THRDC conducted a needs assessment survey of the needs and situation of human right defenders with disability in Tanzania mainland and Zanzibar. The report concludes that HRDDs in Tanzania advocacy work is gradually getting recognition despite facing institutional, financial, and sociocultural challenges.
Outcome 2. THRDCs members and other stakeholders capacities and resilience are strengthened
Digitalization and regular update of membership system has contributed to organizational efficiency, member satisfaction, and strategic decisionmaking. ZCU were provided with tailormade training on risk managementbased approach in devising and implementation of THRDC strategic plans.
The Coalition engaged with 35 different stakeholders with an agenda of improving the HRDs working environment. Among the stakeholders met were the State House, Parliamentarians, Government officials, Judiciary, Tanzania Police Force, and other likeminded organization in attempt to create conducive and secure working environment of HRDs in Tanzania.
Outcome 3. Performance and sustainability of THRDC in Mainland Tanzania
and Zanzibar are enhanced Internal Operational Manual and Policies on Child Protection Policy, Gender Mainstreaming Policy, Resources mobilization Strategy, and capacity development manual developed THRDC Zanzibar is fully operational, and its performance enhanced.
THRDC updated the resource mobilization and sustainability strategy aimed at providing guidance on fund raising.
